figures.finding: The Royal Film Commission's cash rebate pays 25% on USD 250,000 to 1 million of eligible spend in Jordan, 30% on 1 to 10 million and 35% to 45% above 10 million (the extra above 35% on a cultural test), up to USD 5.25 million a project; Jordanian films and series spending over USD 500,000 get 30%; payment comes within 150 days of the audit.

value.name: RFC Cash Rebate
value.postProduction: up to 15% of post costs done in Jordan
value.advance: 10% capped at USD 100,000 against a bank guarantee

figures.applies: Jordan, feature films, series, commercials, documentaries, TV shows and music videos, 2026 rules.

figures.finding: The Jordan Film Fund, run by the Royal Film Commission, funds development, production, post-production, distribution, Arab co-production and shorts for Jordanian producers (or Arab residents of five years); its eleventh cycle, announced 5 October 2026, supported 31 projects, and the twelfth opens in spring 2027.

value.eligibility: Jordanians or Arab nationals resident 5 years; only the producer applies

sources.said: The Royal Film Commission – Jordan Supports 31 Projects Through the Jordan Film Fund Amman, 5 October 2026

The timeline for JFF's 12th cycle will be announced in spring 2027. … Core Team Nationality: Jordanians are eligible to apply, as well as Arab nationals who have resided in Jordan for at least five years
